# Test keys: public, insecure, never for real receipts

These Ed25519 keypairs are committed on purpose so that anyone can
reproduce vouch's test data. Their private keys are public, so a
receipt signed with them proves nothing about who produced it.

| Key | Signs |
|---|---|
| `golden` | `testdata/receipts_golden.jsonl`, generated by `make golden` |
| `eval` | receipts of the real-agent evaluation under `eval/runs/` |

For anything real, create your own key with `vouch keygen` and keep the
private key out of version control (`.pem` files outside `testdata/` are
ignored by `.gitignore`).

`vouch proxy` refuses a private key that other users can read, and git
does not preserve file modes, so tools that use these keys copy them to
a private (0600) temporary file first.
